items.title: Randy Weston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: has a big band. He plays Duke, Basie, everything. He was a good friend of mine. We were in Egypt and we spent time with him, my wife and I. And what happened, they were getting ready to open a new library in Alexandria, in Egypt. He thought I should be there so what he did was he contacted the director of music in Egypt and the director of the library in Alexandria. We got together and we talked and as it turned out, myself and a bass player…I forget his name, he lived in Paris.
No, not Stafford. It’ll come to me.
